description:
We are looking for a Design Engineer with hands\-on experience in SolidWorks and AutoCAD to create and modify 2D/3D engineering designs and manufacturing drawings. 
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 Create and modify 2D/3D drawings using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. 
 





 Develop parts
 

 ,
 

 assemblies
 

 ,
 

 layouts
 

 ,
 

 and manufacturing drawings. 
 





 Ensure designs meet project and manufacturing requirements. 
 





 Coordinate with production and engineering teams for design implementation. Review drawings and make required design changes. 
 





 Maintain drawing revisions and design documentation. 
 




  





**Requirements** 





 Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or related field. 
 





 2\-4 years of experience in mechanical design. 
 





 Good knowledge of SolidWorks and AutoCAD. 
 





 Understanding of engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and basic manufacturing processes. 
 





 Good problem\-solving and communication skills. 
 





 Ability to work independently and with cross\-functional teams.
 




  





**Budget: 3 to 4 Lpa**
